content: User's name is Sam Okafor.
User was born on 14 March 1991.
User lives in Lisbon, Portugal, in the Alfama neighbourhood.
User grew up in Manchester, England.
User speaks English natively, conversational Portuguese, and basic Japanese.
User holds British and Nigerian citizenship.
User is a staff software engineer at Northwind Logistics.
User leads the routing-optimisation team of six engineers.
User's manager is Priya Raman, VP of Engineering.
User's main languages at work are Rust and TypeScript.
User's team deploys on Kubernetes in AWS eu-west-1.
User works remotely and keeps core hours 10:00-16:00 Lisbon time.
User's team has a weekly planning meeting on Monday mornings.
User is migrating the routing service from Python to Rust, targeting completion in Q1 2027.
User previously worked at Monzo for four years on payments infrastructure.
User studied Computer Science at the University of Edinburgh.
User is building a side project called Tidepool, a self-hosted photo library.
Tidepool uses SvelteKit for the frontend and SQLite for storage.
User is writing a book about systems design for small teams, aiming to finish the draft by June 2027.
User is giving a talk on Rust async at RustConf 2027.
User uses Neovim as their main editor.
User prefers dark themes; their favourite colour scheme is Gruvbox.
User prefers small, focused pull requests with descriptive commit messages.
User dislikes ORMs and prefers writing raw SQL.
User prefers pnpm over npm for JavaScript projects.
User wants unit tests written alongside any new code.
Always answer in British English spelling.
Keep answers concise; skip pleasantries and lead with the answer.
When suggesting code, show complete runnable examples rather than fragments.
Don't recommend paid SaaS when a self-hosted option exists.
User types on a split mechanical keyboard (ZSA Moonlander) with a Colemak layout.
User's laptop is a MacBook Pro with an M4 Max; their home server runs Debian.
User is vegetarian.
User is allergic to peanuts.
User loves spicy food, especially Sichuan and Ethiopian cuisine.
User doesn't drink alcohol.
User drinks oat-milk flat whites and avoids coffee after 2pm.
User's partner is Ines, a marine biologist.
User and Ines have been together since 2019; their anniversary is 9 August.
User has a daughter, Ada, born in May 2023.
User has a rescue greyhound named Biscuit.
User's mother, Grace, lives in Manchester.
User's brother, Tunde, is a doctor in Lagos.
User's best friend is Marco, who lives in Porto.
User runs three times a week and is training for the Lisbon Marathon in October 2027.
User plays bass guitar in a jazz trio on weekends.
User is learning to surf at Costa da Caparica.
User enjoys science fiction; favourite authors are Ursula K. Le Guin and Ted Chiang.
User plays chess online, rated about 1650 on Lichess.
User grows tomatoes and herbs on their balcony.
User prefers trains over flying for trips under six hours.
User has a trip to Tokyo planned for April 2027.
User prefers aisle seats when flying.
User usually stays in apartments rather than hotels when travelling.
User likes podcasts about history and economics.
User reads on a Kobo e-reader.
User prefers email over phone calls for anything non-urgent.
User uses Fastmail for email.
User plans their week every Sunday evening in Obsidian.
User needs at least seven hours of sleep and goes to bed around 23:00.
User does not own a car and gets around by bike and metro.
User's favourite film is Spirited Away.
User listens to jazz and Afrobeats while working.
User is on call every sixth week.
User's company uses Linear for issue tracking and Slack for chat.
User's performance review cycle is in November.
User's pronouns are they/them.
Explain trade-offs rather than giving a single answer.
User's daughter Ada attends nursery on weekdays until 17:30.
User volunteers at a coding club for teenagers once a month.
User avoids Google products where possible.
User hosts personal projects on Hetzner.
User prefers metric units and 24-hour time.
User's timezone is Europe/Lisbon.
User is lactose intolerant.
User prefers Markdown for documents and dislikes Word files.
User mentors two junior engineers, Leo and Hana.
User's family celebrates Christmas in Manchester every other year.
